mechanism: Additive hypotensive effects from olmesartan combined with anticholinergic-mediated sympathomimetic activity and CNS anticholinergic effects from oxybutynin; oxybutynin may reduce fluid intake compliance affecting blood pressure control.
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly; counsel patient on adequate hydration and report symptoms of hypotension; consider alternative anticholinergic agents with lower systemic absorption if hypotension becomes problematic.
